label: Blind sample 049: Hansen forest loss 2021, tile 00N_110E

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.05 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2021 (90% interval −0.09 to +0.01). The same test was run on 22 untouched control cells. In 6 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.30). Counted by gap size instead, 1 of the 22 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.09). The interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out.
reasons: the interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
